approved_brief: Modern and warm kitchen refresh. Keep unchanged: the U-shaped layout and all cabinet positions and sizes, the peninsula and its raised ledge, the black sink and tap, the black gas hob, the window, the large light-grey floor tiles, the ceiling, beam and ceiling fans. Fronts: base units in handle-less matte warm greige (cashmere) with slim recessed grips; wall cabinets and the tall unit in light natural oak veneer; the black glass top row replaced with matching oak fronts; the missing doors under the sink added in the same greige. Worktop: warm white quartz with subtle soft veining, about 2 cm thick, also on the peninsula ledge. Walls: smooth matte warm off-white paint; the glossy splashback between worktop and wall cabinets replaced with warm white handmade-look rectangular tiles. Lighting: warm-white (2700 K) LED strip under the wall cabinets, two simple brass-and-opal-glass pendants over the peninsula, existing ceiling spots in warm white. No extra furniture or appliances; keep the worktop clear apart from a few small items.

staging.check: Consistent in all three: layout, sink, hob, window, floor, beam, fans and spots kept; matte greige handle-less base fronts; one continuous row of light oak wall cabinets replacing the white and black glass rows; warm white quartz worktop incl. peninsula ledge; warm off-white walls; LED strip under the wall cabinets; two brass/opal globe pendants over the peninsula. Ignored: Küche_rightview adds a second hob on the sink run (does not exist; the hob is on the peninsula) and leaves the gap under the sink without doors; Küche turns the tall unit into a white open niche (the other two agree on an oak upper cabinet with greige open shelves) and restyles a living-area cabinet (out of scope). Splashback tile pattern differs in every image (vertical stack, square, rectangular); the model uses the brief's rectangular handmade-look tile. All three drop the open niche under the wall cabinets. User decisions: rectangular handmade-look tiles; keep the open niche under the wall cabinets (as in the original, unlike the staged images); keep the two pendants.
